artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan attempting Route 1 only: replace applyRule_emitted_time_mem's OrdTimesKnown hypothesis with a branch-level untlSnceFree condition, propagate through the pick/engine chain to section D4, and record the verdict as a C9 entry 16 amendment either way.

memory_candidates.content: When a Lean development blocks on a semantic run-invariant hypothesis (e.g. OrdTimesKnown b ord) that an interface's universally-quantified clause cannot supply, check whether a SYNTACTIC branch-level condition already carried by that clause's own antecedent shape-gates every proof site consuming the invariant. In BimodalLogic's MintBound.lean, applyRule_emitted_time_mem needed OrdTimesKnown at exactly five rule arms (allFuturePos, allPastPos, someFutureNeg, somePastNeg, orderTrichotomy), and all five are gated by untl/snce-freeness of the branch -- a condition UniverseClosedAt's clause 1 supplies for free via (forall x in b, x in signedUniverse C L), whereas OrdTimesKnown it cannot supply at all. The general pattern: a hypothesis that an interface cannot supply may be replaceable by an incomparable one the interface already implies, and the audit that decides it is a per-proof-site census of where the hypothesis is actually consumed -- not a reading of the theorem's statement. The two forms stay incomparable, so an existing non-removability refutation of the unconditional statement is not contradicted and must be recorded as still standing.
